conclusions: The 38.5x figure is not a pricing error: its denominator is the two canary requests while the provider delta is account-wide and includes live-desktop usage.
The local Command Code token arithmetic matches the published off-peak rates exactly.
The provider's 5h and weekly windows and monthly remaining credits move together; the billing-period usage summary is a separate pool and does not reconcile exactly.
The router now derives monthly usage from the stable provider window grant minus the authoritative remaining balance; the summary is diagnostic only.
Exact per-request provider attribution is not possible from the aggregate billing windows; no request-level provider history was available.
